categories.main_business_segments: Three Squirrels Inc. primarily operates in the snack food industry, focusing on nuts, baked goods, meat products, dried fruits, and comprehensive snack categories. The company runs a 'full-category + full-channel' business model integrating manufacturing, branding, and retail. It also operates multiple sub-brands including 'Xiaolu Lanlan' targeting children's high-end healthy snacks and several emerging brands in vertical categories such as convenience foods, health foods, chocolates, and prepared dishes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced manufacturing with a vertically integrated supply chain, including global direct sourcing of raw materials and self-owned production facilities. It invests in R&D for health-oriented product innovations such as sugar-free and low-GI baked goods, natural preservation technologies, and flavor enhancement techniques. It holds numerous patents and operates high-level research centers, including a national engineering technology research center for nut snacks, focusing on product quality and process innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Three Squirrels serves a broad consumer base across China, targeting general snack consumers and specialized segments like children’s healthy snacks. Its products are sold through major e-commerce platforms (Douyin, Tmall, JD.com) and offline retail channels including franchise and direct-operated stores. The company’s key customers include individual consumers nationwide and regional distributors, with a strong presence in both online and offline retail markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily concentrated in China, with extensive supply chain bases and sales networks across eastern, northern, southwestern, and southern regions. It has established multiple supply chain hubs in Anhui, Tianjin, and Sichuan provinces and plans further expansion in Southeast Asia for global sourcing. Its retail stores and distribution channels cover numerous provinces and cities throughout China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Three Squirrels operates as an integrated midstream and downstream player in the snack food supply chain. It controls upstream raw material procurement through direct global sourcing, owns manufacturing facilities for processing and packaging, and manages branding and retail distribution channels. The company’s 'manufacturing, brand, retail' integrated model enables control over the entire value chain from raw materials to end consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on the 'high-end cost-performance' model, emphasizing product quality, differentiation, and affordability. R&D priorities include health-oriented innovations such as sugar-free baked goods, natural preservation, flavor enhancement, and functional nutrition products for children. It also invests in digital transformation, supply chain integration, and organizational innovation to support multi-brand expansion and full-channel sales growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of snack foods across multiple channels. The company sells via third-party e-commerce platforms, its own online stores, offline franchise and direct-operated retail stores, and distribution to regional dealers. It also earns income from licensing and brand-related activities, but the core revenue driver remains product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Three Squirrels is a leading player in China's snack food industry, especially in the nut segment where it has maintained the top sales position for eight consecutive years. The market is fragmented with low concentration, but the company leverages its strong brand recognition, extensive fan base, and integrated supply chain to maintain competitive advantages. It competes with other emerging and established snack brands focusing on quality and health trends.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Three Squirrels reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 10.62 billion, a 49.3% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 407.7 million, up 85.5%. The company has shown strong growth in sales volume, production capacity, and cash flow generation. It operates with total assets of about RMB 6.77 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.83 billion, reflecting steady expansion and improved profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering 'high-end cost-performance' products that combine superior quality, health attributes, and affordable pricing. Its vertically integrated supply chain and advanced R&D capabilities enable it to offer differentiated, innovative snack products that meet evolving consumer demands for health and taste. The strong brand equity of 'Three Squirrels' and its multi-brand portfolio further enhance customer loyalty and market competitiveness.
